legend.//: full stop, about 0.8 s, let it land
legend.[lens]: lean in slightly, eyes on the lens
legend.[point]: point up at the graphic (Format A) or at the screen side (Format B)
legend.broll: B-roll to film after the take (3 to 5 s each, no talking)

defaults.pace: aim for 190 to 210 words a minute inside a sentence (Kallaway runs 210 to 240); keep a short beat between lines, never a long one
defaults.energy: 7 out of 10: awake and warm, not a hype voice
defaults.framing: chest up, a hand's width of space above your head, eyes on the lens
defaults.retake: If you fluff a line, pause, then say the whole line again. The edit keeps the last take.
defaults.broll: After the talking take, film the B-roll list on the same phone: 3 to 5 s each, steady, no talking, good light. Film your hands and screens more than your face. The edit cuts to one every few lines (research/creators/style-guide-2026-10-14.md).
defaults.angle: Film the hook and the CTA a second time from a different angle (wide, standing, or side) so the edit can cut between angles like @justyn.ai.

sheets.cta: Ask: where are you starting from?
sheets.hook: No German. / No job offers. // And I just *booked a flight*.
hook_alts: For years I wanted to do this. / I never had the confidence.
I moved to a country / where I don't speak the language.
My life is all over the place, / and this is Day 1.
I'm Vish, 27, / and I never had the confidence to post this.

lines.say: I'm Vish, I'm 27, / and this is my *first video*.
lines.see: Hard cut to you, plain, no effects, no music; small tag 'vish, 27 · video 001'

lines.say: For years I wanted to do this. / I'd start, *doubt* myself, and stop.
lines.see: Paper world, words typed in lowercase, red pen circles 'doubt'; three quick clips of you hitting record and putting the phone down

lines.say: A year ago I moved to Germany. / I overthought it. / I doubted *everything*.
lines.see: Your clips: walking alone, train window, staring at the laptop; small 1 YEAR AGO stamp

lines.say: No friends here. / No family. / Every application comes back // "*unfortunately*."
lines.see: Table for one, then your real rejection emails (names blurred), red UNFORTUNATELY stamps and a counter

lines.say: And this week, / a two-and-a-half-year relationship ended.
lines.see: One shot only: the door closing. No text, no lingering
lines.how: quick and quiet, move straight on

lines.say: On paper: / five years in influencer marketing, / and I've taught yoga.
lines.see: Childhood photo snaps to you now; pixel icons orbit your head; stickers 5 YEARS · 850+ CREATOR DEALS · TAUGHT YOGA

lines.say: My life is all over the place. // But I know *one* thing.
lines.see: Chaos collage with a riser, then a black frame and half a second of silence

lines.say: I want to work remotely / while *travelling the world*.
lines.see: The music drops: ocean jump, bike riding, travel clips

lines.say: Before my thesis ends in *February*, / my laptop has to pay me.
lines.see: Thesis over your shoulder, calendar flips to FEB 2027, a euro counter at 0

lines.say: I don't know how yet. // This is *Day 1*.
lines.see: Back in your room, same framing as the hook; red DAY 1 stamp

lines.say: I'll film all of it: / the work, / the travel, / the *fails*.
lines.see: Three 0.5 s flashes: laptop, plane window, you losing balance in a yoga pose
Hard cut to the two dancing cats with 'me' / 'you' arrows, then the end card: where are you starting from?

sheets.notes: Facts from Vish (21 to 22 Oct 2026): 27; moved to Germany a year ago; no German, no friends or family here; job hunting with many rejections; 2.5-year relationship ended this week (one quiet line only); 5 years in influencer marketing, 850+ creator deals; taught yoga; thesis on AI in marketing ends Feb 2027; goal: earn remotely while travelling (made it = EUR 3,000 to 5,000 a month); flight booked, destination revealed in Day 2. Film all 5 hooks, then the full script start to finish 3 ways (deadpan, slower, long pauses), then lines 1 to 8 again as a close-mic voiceover. Lookbook: https://claude.ai/artifact/SK2dN2bbZzosbRMobG6eWw One clean full take also becomes a raw edit for TikTok.
broll: Phone with the booking screen pushed fast at the lens (3 takes)
Hitting record, hesitating, putting the phone down (3 takes, 2 s)
Squinting at a German letter, then the translate app over it (3 s)
Side profile against a plain wall, looking down (10 s)
The door closing from inside; you on the bed edge, back to camera
Staring at the laptop; hands typing; thesis over the shoulder
One yoga pose, plus one take losing your balance
Outside: walking away from camera, table for one from above, train or tram window
